title: SDK roadmap stitching sync — quick notes
body:
Meeting: DevExp cross-stream sync (SDKs / Samples / Quickstarts) — 2026-09-21
Owner: Asha Patel
Attendees: Asha, Ethan, Marisol, Kai, Liam (partial)

Purpose: rapid alignment to 'stitch' upcoming 3-week SDK roadmap with docs quickstarts and sample apps. We want to avoid last-minute doc gaps during the SDK 1.5 release and make sure sample apps demonstrate new streaming + tool-calling API flows.

Quick updates (round-robin):
- Asha: SDK release target semicondensed: feature freeze Thu 09/23, tagging Tue 09/28. Main open item: streaming backpressure behavior on node sdk (flaky in e2e harness).
- Ethan: samples repo needs new streaming example + small refactor to run against local Redwood Private (add env var toggles). PR ready but needs API call signature change (see PR #894).
- Marisol: Quickstarts draft updated to include 'deploy to Redwood Dedicated' path. Need screenshots for console rollouts page. Will capture next week during demo.
- Kai: Telemetry hooks for token-level breakdown ready; waiting on SDK client event shape confirmation.
- Liam: Docs review — flagged multiple places where function-calling examples lack typed schema examples.

Decisions made:
1) Merge pattern: samples may temporarily call an SDK feature-flagged endpoint. Feature flags will be clearly annotated in READMEs. No blocking for SDK merge.
2) Streaming parity: Node and Python SDKs must expose identical 'cancel' semantics. If node cannot guarantee before freeze, we'll ship with a clear caveat in CHANGELOG and mark a follow-up task.

Action items (owner — due):
- Asha: run e2e on latest node sdk with streaming harness + post backtrace on Slack #devexp by 2026-09-22. (ENGDX-482)
- Ethan: convert samples PR to use new client.method signature; add local env toggles and env docs in README — due 2026-09-24. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/210)
- Marisol: capture Dedicated flow screenshots and upload to Confluence page; drop into quickstart draft — due 2026-09-27. (Confluence: sdk-roadmap page)
- Kai: finalize telemetry event spec and publish event schema to the sdk repo (json schema file) — due 2026-09-23. Blocker: waiting on final field names from SDK (coordinate with Asha).
- Liam: add typed schema examples for function-calling in docs; prepare doc PR and ping docs-owners for review — due 2026-09-25.

Blockers / Risks:
- Node streaming instability: if unresolved, we may ship with caveats (user-facing breakage risk minimal but developer experience worse).
- Console screenshots: Marisol needs a stable Dedicated demo tenant; product/console scheduling required. She'll ping Console PM for a demo slot.
- Telemetry schema drift: if field names change after SDK cut, sample app telemetry tests will fail. Plan: freeze event names one working day before SDK feature freeze.

Notes / Discussion fragments:
- We debated whether sample apps should prefer hosted API examples vs. Dedicated/local examples. Conclusion: maintain both, but prioritize 'dev-first' local quickstarts (easy to run) and add a short 'Deploy to Hosted' appendix.
- Suggested small quick wins to reduce friction: add a single-file quickstart that uses the streaming example and writes output to a local temp file — low effort and great demo for conferences.
- For the CHANGELOG entry: include clear wording about function-calling schema changes and streaming caveats. Marisol to draft wording.

Follow-ups / next sync:
- Quick demo sync: Tue 2026-09-22 10:30am PT (Asha to run node streaming e2e live).
- Merge window check-in: Thu 2026-09-23 4pm PT to confirm feature freeze status.

Raw notes / shorthand (copied from meeting):
- streaming/backpressure: node harness triggers memory bump after ~500 messages; looks like chunk buffer not draining fast enough.
- PR #894 touches client.method signature, need small shim for backwards compat.
- add 'redwood.local' env var flow in samples; doc snippet + docker-compose quickstart.
- CONSOLE PM: @casey to provide demo tenant by 09/24 — Marisol to follow up.

Context links (quick):
- SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/894
- Samples PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/210
- Jira task for e2e: ENGDx-482
- Confluence draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVEXP/pages/56789-sdk-roadmap

End of notes.
